packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers are finalizing preparations for their 2026 season opener against the division-rival Minnesota Vikings on Sunday, with the game being especially notable since running back Josh Jacobs is currently on the commissioner's exempt list, meaning he is unable to practice or play with the team . In roster moves this week, the Packers signed Kahlef Hailassie to the practice squad and released Murvin Kenion , while also adding depth at running back amid the uncertainty at that position.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The biggest Vikings story is safety Harrison Smith's return for his 15th season, as the Minnesota Vikings expect Harrison Smith to pursue a Week 1 return against the Green Bay Packers, potentially with a limited workload. His new contract gives Minnesota added flexibility, since Harrison Smith's new deal gives the Vikings flexibility, with $8.25 million guaranteed and another $8 million tied to availability and team success.
